pos.personaBrief: Leverkusen had the league's highest possession (58-62%) and fewest shots faced, but Alonso said 'sometimes we have to wait and defend compact' and gave up the ball at Bayern (38%) while winning.

pro.personaBrief: Methodical build-up with a back-line breakout and the wing-backs advancing, quick but methodical progression; Xhaka as line-breaking passer; not a long-ball side.

est.personaBrief: Positional play with a defined 3-4-2-1 and rehearsed shape changes, with the two 10s and Boniface dropping and combining centrally; wing-backs provide the width.

lar.personaBrief: Second-lowest crosses in the Bundesliga, a preference for progressing centrally, and two 10s in the half-spaces; width comes only from wing-backs.

blo.personaBrief: High press with 238 high turnovers and immediate counter-pressing, but a mid-block 5-2-3 and a compact block against Bayern; not a deep-block side by default.

mar.personaBrief: Man-oriented marking when pressing high and one-to-one defending against Bayern, reverting to space defending afterwards; no evidence of a dedicated star marker.

pla.personaBrief: Alonso kept his principles but adapted by opponent (back four vs Bayern, adjustments vs Leipzig); the model was built with his chosen signings.

res.personaBrief: Dominant, positive football that also won everything domestically; 17 stoppage-time goals show an urge to win, with an attractive style valued as a means.

sis.personaBrief: A collective system with defined roles; everyone, stars included (Wirtz), works within the structure; Andrich sacrificed his place for the team.

jog.personaBrief: Technical, positional team (Xhaka, Wirtz, Palacios) with pace and intensity; passing quality is favoured over brute physicality.

bas.personaBrief: Signings with average age 25.9, experienced additions (Xhaka, Grimaldo, Hofmann), a settled XI and few youth minutes except in dead-rubber games.

lid.personaBrief: Alonso has no ego, is emotionally intelligent and builds team spirit; Rolfes picks players for harmony, with rotation and rest managed fairly.
